name: 'Aumadachi: Raveled Hearts
source:
Hanaki Umichigi, a student of the Dreamist House, was living the same life over and over - never seeing anything new. With her loyal 'Aumadachi, Pochibi, the cycle of a mundane life endlessly loops. 

Hunahe Gralla, a student of the Rascallion House, was feeling the piercing glares of his peers, getting agitated from being viewed as a pariah. With his loyal 'Aumadachi, Gakuniki, the cycle of judgement continues to spiral.

A pair of separated childhood friends, yearning to reunite once more to cure their hardships.

Will Hanaki and Hunahe overcome their perpetual cycles upon meeting again? 

[From [url=https://pau-hanaki-isle.itch.io/aumadachi-raveled-hearts-demo]itch.io[/url]]
